defs.def: to take sb/sth in your hand suddenly and using force 抓住；捉住；夺

ex.s: Looking back, I now see that this would be the first in a series of timely opportunities that my old self would have let pass, but that this new and more confident Alice enthusiastically seized.
ex.t: 回顾往事，我现在明白这将是第一个及时机会，旧的我可能会让它溜走，而这个新的、更自信的Alice热情地抓住了。

ex.s: 16．（30分）I was ready to pay for my bananas at the grocery one night， when fear seized me． My wallet was gone． I could only have left it on the G9 bus， which was now speeding in the dark to some（1）     station．

defs.def: to take control of a place or situation, often suddenly and violently （常指通过暴力突然）夺取，攻占，控制

ex.s: Prince Hamlet is called upon by the supernatural to take revenge upon his uncle, Claudius, who has murdered his brother the king, seized the throne and married the dead king's widow in unseemly haste.
ex.t: 哈姆雷特王子受超自然力量召唤，要向他叔叔克劳狄斯复仇，克劳狄斯谋杀了他的哥哥——国王，夺取了王位，并匆忙且不体面地娶了已故国王的遗孀。

ex.s: At last, showing a strong will and the steeliest nerves, they played a close match against Serbia to seize gold in the final.
ex.t: 最后，凭借坚强的意志和钢铁般的神经，她们在决赛与塞尔维亚队进行了紧张激烈的一战，夺得了金牌。

ex.s: He seized Tom by the jaw, and pulled open his mouth to inspect his teeth; made him strip up his sleeve, to show his muscle; turned him round, made him jump and spring, to show his paces.
ex.t: 他抓住汤姆的下巴，掰开他的嘴检查牙齿；让他卷起袖子展示肌肉；让他转身、跳跃，展示他的步态。

ex.s: Towards the end of this year the old man, then eighty-two, was seized by paralysis, which made rapid progress.
ex.t: 这一年接近年底时，这位82岁的老人突然中风，病情迅速恶化。

defs.def: to arrest or capture sb 逮捕；捉拿；俘获
to take illegal or stolen goods away from sb 起获；没收；扣押
to be quick to make use of a chance, an opportunity, etc. 抓住，把握（机会、时机、主动等）
to affect sb suddenly and deeply 情绪
to stop moving or working correctly 机器部件
if a part of your body seizes up, you are unable to move it easily and it is often painful （身体）发僵

ex.s: If I approach near to people, a hot terror seizes upon me, and I fear being exposed to the danger that my weakness might be noticed.
ex.t: 如果我靠近人群，一阵炽热的恐惧就会攫住我，我害怕被人发现自己的弱点而暴露在危险中。
